verdict.rationale: pnpm documents lockfile-enforced installs. In CI it automatically switches to frozen-lockfile mode and fails if the lockfile is present but needs an update. Checksum verification is only bypassed via an explicit --update-checksums opt-in, and a single shared lockfile covers whole workspaces. One community comment prefers yarn3 for reproducibility, but it is general opinion, not a concrete failure. missing for 10: explicit documentation of frozen-lockfile behavior on developer machines outside CI, an explicit statement that resolved versions are pinned identically across machines, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-machine determinism.
